verdict: Leads are down and Google spend is not converting — both being addressed now.
narrative: This period, you received 31 leads at an average cost per lead of $135.76, with all tracked leads coming through Meta. Google Ads consumed $2,747.11 of the $4,208.71 total spend and produced only 2 conversions — a cost per conversion of roughly $1,373 — which is not a workable result and is being corrected. Lead volume has slowed materially over the last week, down 37.5% compared to the prior 7-day window, and cost per lead rose 60% in that same stretch. On the pipeline side, 112 opportunities have been created but none have moved to won, so we are reviewing the intake and follow-up process to make sure leads that do arrive are being contacted and closed. Next period, you should expect Google spend to be redeployed more efficiently and lead flow from Meta to stabilize as creative and targeting adjustments take effect.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending at full pace while converting at a rate that is entirely unworkable — roughly $1,373 per conversion over the last 28 days.
watch_item.fix: Spend allocation and campaign structure are being reviewed this week to stop the bleed and redirect budget toward what is actually converting.
